_note: Betting rules backed by backtests against closing lines. Edit these when weekly grading says so.

tz_spot.hit: 55% overall (129), 59% since 2021; 62% if kickoff 10pm ET or later (69)

nfl.side_note: no proven edge vs closing line; small-stake leans only, key numbers 3/7

betting._note: Which picks become bets and how $ are split. p = backtest hit rate vs closing line, n = games behind it.
betting._stake_method: fractional Kelly on a shrunk hit rate (p*n + 0.5*k)/(n + k), scaled so each day's stakes add to the budget

cfb_total_gap7.src: leave-one-season-out 2023-25 vs closing totals (2023 44.7%/94, 2024 52.9%/34, 2025 59.3%/54); was 60%/55 on 2025 alone

cfb_wind_under.src: published CFB wind studies (n discounted - not our data)

nfl_side_gap4.src: our 2025 NFL test (below threshold - lean only)

nfl_key_side.src: key-number cover probability (Normal around the closing line x historical margin frequencies), edge >= 1 pt over the price, walk-forward 2023-25 at actual closing odds: 35-22, +21% ROI; small sample

betting.excluded: time-zone spots where the model disagrees; any game passed with --skip
betting._lean_note: lean_only rules are shown and graded on the report card but never become bets until their live record earns it
